\section[(dialogue)]{Places, can and want — a first pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R116-first-pass-places-can-and-want}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a lock and a nail.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item right, left, straight, far; distance, above
  \item below, outside, in front, in the middle, a road
  \item a bridge, a park, a temple, a library, a bank
  \item a market, a beach, a garden, a corner, a turn
  \item a hotel, a train, an aeroplane, a car, a bicycle
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Right? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಲ}}, \emph{bala}.) Left? (\textbf{\kn{ಎಡ}}, \emph{eḍa}.) Straight? (\textbf{\kn{ನೇರ}}, \emph{nēra}.) Far; distance? (\textbf{\kn{ದೂರ}}, \emph{dūra}.) Above? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೇಲೆ}}, \emph{mēle}.) Below? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೆಳಗೆ}}, \emph{keḷage}.) Outside? (\textbf{\kn{ಹೊರಗೆ}}, \emph{horage}.) In front? (\textbf{\kn{ಮುಂದೆ}}, \emph{munde}.) In the middle? (\textbf{\kn{ನಡುವೆ}}, \emph{naḍuve}.) A road? (\textbf{\kn{ರಸ್ತೆ}}, \emph{rastē}.) A bridge? (\textbf{\kn{ಸೇತುವೆ}}, \emph{sētuve}.) A park? (\textbf{\kn{ಉದ್ಯಾನ}}, \emph{udyāna}.) A temple? (\textbf{\kn{ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನ}}, \emph{dēvasthāna}.) A library? (\textbf{\kn{ಗ್ರಂಥಾಲಯ}}, \emph{granthālaya}.) A bank? (\textbf{\kn{ಬ್ಯಾಂಕು}}, \emph{byāṅku}.) A market? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಂತೆ}}, \emph{sante}.) A beach? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಡಲತೀರ}}, \emph{kaḍalatīra}.) A garden? (\textbf{\kn{ತೋಟ}}, \emph{tōṭa}.) A corner? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೂಲೆ}}, \emph{mūle}.) A turn? (\textbf{\kn{ತಿರುವು}}, \emph{tiruvu}.) A hotel? (\textbf{\kn{ಹೋಟೆಲ್}}, \emph{hōṭel}.) A train? (\textbf{\kn{ರೈಲು}}, \emph{railu}.) An aeroplane? (\textbf{\kn{ವಿಮಾನ}}, \emph{vimāna}.) A car? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಾರು}}, \emph{kāru}.) A bicycle? (\textbf{\kn{ಸೈಕಲ್}}, \emph{saikal}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Why and the house — a second pass}

\label{lesson:KA-R116-second-pass-why-and-the-house}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for ability and a skill.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item ability, a skill, a right, a chance, a tool
  \item property, an owner, strength, a wish, a dream
  \item an intention, a plan, a need, a decision, to wish for
  \item a reason, therefore, that is why, because, a bed
  \item a pillow, a blanket, a curtain, a lock, a nail
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Ability? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ}}, \emph{sāmarthya}.) A skill? (\textbf{\kn{ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ}}, \emph{kauśalya}.) A right? (\textbf{\kn{ಹಕ್ಕು}}, \emph{hakku}.) A chance? (\textbf{\kn{ಅವಕಾಶ}}, \emph{avakāśa}.) A tool? (\textbf{\kn{ಸಾಧನ}}, \emph{sādhana}.) Property? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಸ್ತಿ}}, \emph{āsti}.) An owner? (\textbf{\kn{ಯಜಮಾನ}}, \emph{yajamāna}.) Strength? (\textbf{\kn{ಶಕ್ತಿ}}, \emph{śakti}.) A wish? (\textbf{\kn{ಆಸೆ}}, \emph{āse}.) A dream? (\textbf{\kn{ಕನಸು}}, \emph{kanasu}.) An intention? (\textbf{\kn{ಉದ್ದೇಶ}}, \emph{uddēśa}.) A plan? (\textbf{\kn{ಯೋಜನೆ}}, \emph{yōjane}.) A need? (\textbf{\kn{ಅಗತ್ಯ}}, \emph{agatya}.) A decision? (\textbf{\kn{ನಿರ್ಧಾರ}}, \emph{nirdhāra}.) To wish for? (\textbf{\kn{ಬಯಸು}}, \emph{bayasu}.) A reason? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಾರಣ}}, \emph{kāraṇa}.) Therefore? (\textbf{\kn{ಆದುದರಿಂದ}}, \emph{ādudarinda}.) That is why? (\textbf{\kn{ಅದಕ್ಕೇ}}, \emph{adakkē}.) Because? (\textbf{\kn{ಯಾಕೆಂದರೆ}}, \emph{yākendare}.) A bed? (\textbf{\kn{ಮಂಚ}}, \emph{maṁca}.) A pillow? (\textbf{\kn{ದಿಂಬು}}, \emph{dimbu}.) A blanket? (\textbf{\kn{ಕಂಬಳಿ}}, \emph{kambaḷi}.) A curtain? (\textbf{\kn{ಪರದೆ}}, \emph{parade}.) A lock? (\textbf{\kn{ಬೀಗ}}, \emph{bīga}.) A nail? (\textbf{\kn{ಮೊಳೆ}}, \emph{moḷe}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
